remarks: *HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY TUESDAY May 5th at 12:00pm.* Move right into this beautiful 1-bedroom ranch style condo in the heart of Springdale offering comfort, convenience, and a peaceful setting. This pet-friendly unit features hardwood floors throughout, freshly painted, and an abundance of natural light. The spacious living room/dining area provides plenty of room to relax or entertain. The kitchen is equipped w/stainless steel refrigerator, stove and dishwasher- perfect for everyday living. The generous sized primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet, while the lovely bath adds charm. Additional highlights include a private storage room with your own washer/dryer, (1) car garage parking plus (1) reserved parking space. Nestled in a quiet complex with serene surroundings, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy and easy living.  Enjoy being within walking distance to shops, restaurants, park, library and so much more. Convenient access to the Merritt making commuting a breeze.
